item.title: Helix supplies dual-motor propulsion system delivering 1,000 hp for McMurtry Spéirling hypercar
item.description: UK-based electric motor manufacturer Helix has developed a bespoke dual-motor propulsion system for the McMurtry Spéirling, the single-seater electric fan hypercar that holds records at Goodwood and Laguna Seca. item.title: Minespider launches digital marketplace for second-life EV batteries and recycled materials
item.description: Berlin-based traceability firm Minespider has launched Recircle.market, a digital marketplace designed to connect companies across the EV battery reuse, refurbishment and recycling value chain. The platform enables listing and trading of second-life batteries with verified technical and lifecycle data, sourcing of recycled battery materials and components, and connecting with service providers for testing, diagnostics, logistics,... item.title: Zūm launches fully electric school bus fleet in Branford, Connecticut
item.description: Student transportation provider Zūm will deploy a fully electric school bus fleet for Branford Public Schools in Connecticut, beginning in the 2026-27 school year.
